Gunstechgic:
"Gunstechgic, or known as Sorcytech, is an unique fusion of arcane energies with magic firearms. Because traditional magic or medieval weaponry never existed in Ordonia back then 1 billion years ago in the start, Guntechgic integrates supernatural elements into modern technology, enhancing firearms, explosives, and vehicles with magical properties. This integration allows for the creation of highly advanced military technology, such as enchanted firearms and upgraded war vehicles. Guntechgic manifests in various specialized forms, such as Firearm Gunstely, Supernatural Smithing, Vehicle Gunstely, Ballistic Gunstely, and Psykic Gunnery. These specialized forms focus on crafting firearms with magical properties, upgrading war vehicles, controlling explosive weaponry, and manipulating projectiles and the battlefield, respectively. This type of magic exclusively aims to enhance combat efficiency and the effectiveness of weaponry, making Ordonian magic users akin to specialized combatants rather than traditional spellcasters from other worlds."
Biotechgic:
"Another type of Gunstechgic where it practices bio weapons with Gunstechgic powers, containing horrific anomalies and using parasites and anomalies as their power. This also allow them to use bio mass manipulation to manipulate flesh, bio mass, and parasites even infected."
Who posses gunstechgic?
"Gunstechgic are possessed by Gun mages, Arcane operators and Gunards. This reflect the unique blend of arcane and military skill in Ordonia/UCO. All of the magic firearms are based on Real life weapons like M4A1, Kar98k, M1 garand, Thompson tommy gun, etc...It is unknown how these similiar firearms from Earth existed in billion of years ago, but rumors said that Ordonia's deities aka the deities of Modern warfare, read the Earth's future history."
Deities of Ordonia
"Those deities play a significiant role in shaping society's value and advancements. Example, The main deities are Ares-tek is known as the main deity of Firearms and combat, Machina, the goddess of Military tech, oversees the invention and the technological innovation that existed 1 billion years ago, which Gunstechgic starts. Ballista, the god of explosions and artillery shells, even ballistic missiles. The other gods are Pyronus, god of Incendiary warfare and flamethrowers, Ferrum, who governs Metallurgy, Empulsianis, the goddess of EMPs and Electronic warfare, Aeron, the goddess of Aviation warfare, Dismarker, the god of naval warfare and submarine warfare, and Voltrix, the god of Cyber warfare. Those gods exist for a reason in order to start a world where it has no "Traditional magic" Entirely. Its not forgotten or anything, all of "Traditional magic," "Swords," And "Bows," They dont all exist in the first place at all. Its just pure firearms according to history."
Differences between Ordonian magic firearms and Ordonian made firearms
"These firearms are not just only tools, but they are part of an individual being, summoned directly of the wielder's inner self without rituals or chants. Magic firearms are based on Real life weapons, that can be used for elemental attacks and telekinetics. In contrast, Ordonian made firearms are purely tech and lack Gunstechgic enchancements, designed for weak gunstechgic users developed by Gunstechgic scientists."
History of Ordonia 1 billion ECEOY to 500 MIillion ECEOY
"In the beginning of ECEOY (Early CEO years) 1 billion years ago, the CEOs existed and they were known as divine figures of the Ordonia religion called "The way of innovation and modern warfare." These early figures founded Gunstechgic, that blends magic and firearms with technology together. The suite officers are like the modern noble family, but instead, they call it "The suite family" while the royal family in modern are called "Entrepreneur executive families." This is where they started the "Ordonian Democracy.""
Rise of The corporations 500M ECEOY to 400M ECEOY,:
"After inspired by the first CEO existed name "Dominic Clarke," Other suite officer families begin to rise up and build their own corporations like PMCs, Corporate bussiness financial, and other types of corporates. Those who failed to be suite officers or Entrepreneur family member, some of them started their own independent "Platoon," "Company," "Battalion," "Brigade," "Division" or "Corp" sometimes "Field army." Because there are no such things as "Clans" entirely in Ordonia, they just have from Platoons to Field army. Some groups support the corporations, while some work independently."
The struggle wars between groups and corporations 300M ECEOY to 1M ECEOY.
"During the power and control of millions of years, alot of corporates and groups and division begin to declare war at each other to gain superiority and more territory. This caused a million struggle between platoons to Field army and Pmcs and Corporates to others. More gas attacks, explosives and even alliances betrayal, trying to gain the superiority for the sake of the strongest of all Ordonian corporate nation."
The unification of United corporations of Ordonia 1M ECEOY to 0 CCEOY:
"The rise of the UCO happen after CEO Davin N Lester's army after hiding for millions of years emerged, after stopping all corporations and seizing all territory, David N lester begins to recognize UCO needs stability and order. So, he uses all the resources he developed and hiding for years to unite all various corporations and paramilitaries even groups. The efforts he did led the formation of the United corporations of Ordonia or known as "UCO." During for 1 million years, he developed the managed democracy after the "Ordonian democracy" has been there for 1 billion of years, making sure no one will go against the new Ordonia's age. The managed democracy emphasized military power, tech superiority and the master of Gunstechgic energies, but also guaranteed individual freedoms and democratic princpiles as long they follow the law. Millions of years until the Current CEO years."
The rise of the new Democracy of Ordonia 0 CCEOY to 2000 CCEOY:
"After the unification, the CEOs and chairmans begin to make their own decision to start their own new democracy for UCO called "Representative democracy" and "Permissive democracy." This allows broader participation in Governance, Emphasizing individual rights and democratic principles while maintaining strong corporate and PMC structure. Some corporations has represntative democracy while some has permissive, while others have managed democracy."
The new CEO of UCO: in CCEOY 2010s late to early 2020s:
"Adam mark, is the central figure in all Ordonian politics. He is the CEO of the most dominant state of UCO aka the "Industries of modern warfare." Adam mark, always has confidence, assertiveness, and a strong desire for public recognition. He often demonstrates a competitive nature, a focus on personal branding, and a preference for direct and unfiltered communication. Known for his charisma and ability to command attention, he tends to embrace bold decision-making, valuing loyalty and success. Critics and supporters alike often note his penchant for self-promotion and resilience in the face of controversy, alongside a tendency to polarize opinions. His bodyguards, the lawyer thugs, are like the CIA and secret services, but despite them being the smartest and the quickest, they are all abrasive, informal, and always mostly swears. They always blend in ruthless efficiency with crass behavior."
Names of Ordonia
"Sooo the names there in Ordonia are influenced by American, Russian, British, and Canadian cultures, reflecting the society’s emphasis on modern military themes. This blend of names aligns with the Ordonian ethos, where modernity and warfare are intertwined.."
Races in Ordonia
"Ordonia has races like Humans, ghouls, mutants, Synths, robots, Aritficial intelligence, radioactive mutants, zombies of Ordonia who are unlike typical zombies in other worlds, Ordonian zombies are smarter and can think like humans."
National anthem of Ordonia: "Freedom will rise."
""Freedom must reign over every last star, Through Ordonian's blood spilled in our righteous wars, Honor their deaths, do your part for the cause. Steadfast support of our world realm, Is how Ordonians will reign supreme, No questions or doubts shall be allowed, Enemies will all be disavowed. Representive democracy the way, All who attack us shall suffer our guns, Gunstechgic flying on all our world, Justice and hope are forever unfurled. Our way of life, Modern tech wide, Paved with the men of those who've died, Unsinkable tide of Ordonia pride, A torrent that can't be satisfied. We sacrifice for Innovation, Anything more will bring freedom, Moderates rise, liberty rides, Ordonia pride's up to the skies. Stay free!" The anthem is typically performed with a powerful and majestic orchestration, featuring instruments such as drums, trumpets, violins, slide trumpets, bass violin, and a full orchestra. The combination of these instruments creates a grand and inspiring sound, perfectly capturing the essence of UCO's pride, strength, and unity"
Problems in UCO
"Just because its democracy, doesnt mean it doesnt have a dark side. UCO has like mostly psycological terrorists, mostly "Ordonian rappers" And "Ordonian dissers," They mostly diss people's privarcy and their personal lives. Even Ordonian heisters and terrorists happen in Ordonia."
Ordonia aka the ridiculous overpowered superpower of all:
"Ordonia is now one of the most democratic and known to be the strongest of all realms, because of relying on "Magic firearms," "Intelligences," "Has too many budget like 900 Quadrillion," "Builds alot of bases and corporates," "One of having the most smartest people on math and science," Ordonia is known as the "The Dimensional world of Corporations and Pmcs." UCO even build corporates and bases around other dimensions to secure other places."
Life in Ordonia:
"Living in Ordonia even is a militarized world doesnt mean civillians are not allowed to roam around. Atleast, they are having their personal freedoms and living like civillians. Like the US, alot of them are patriots with alot of patriotism, with the pride of Ordonian history. Ordonia cities are like Dubai, New york, and even advanced Earth like cities."
Ordonian Marine culture
"Unlike alot of other worlds having warrior culture, Ordonia doesnt have this "Warrior culture" entirely, they have instead marine corp culture. Marine culture is all about being as "Devil dogs," And fighting for the nation and saving the people. Marine culture can also have humor as the marines mostly talk to each other while waiting for the war and making jokes while waiting and during fights."
Dark Ordonia:
"Dark Ordonia, also known as Communist Ordonia, is a radical faction within the world of Ordonia that represents extreme zealotry and the overthrow of established societal structures. The followers of Dark Ordonia adhere to the teachings of Zealothar, the god of pure communism. Their primary goal is to spread chaos and dismantle the existing order in Ordonia, using highly dangerous and radical forms of Guntechgic. This faction employs guerrilla warfare, sabotage, and psychological operations to undermine the stability of Ordonia, utilizing bioweapons and horrific anomalies to create widespread destruction. The organizational structure of Dark Ordonia is strict and militant, with leaders fervently devoted to their cause. They are willing to use extreme measures to achieve their goals, often resulting in significant instability and chaos. Communists mostly destroy other dimensions' culture, even cause too much warcrimes in the name of "Communism.""
After life in Ordonia
"The afterlife says that Ordonia has a place called "Retirement world," This is where they begin to rest in the heaven retirement for 30 years before going back and being reincarnated. While the hell version is called "Communist world," those who commits too much warcrimes and do not repent their warcrimes seems Sins dont exist in Ordonia but instead they call it "Warcrimes." Those who caused too much warcrimes are either sent to the Communist world as a tornment of 1000 years or worse if they extend depending their crimes without repenting their warcrimes."))
((The United Corporations of Ordonia (UCO), despite its advanced society and technological prowess, is not without its darker sides. Corruption and extremist factions exist within its borders, reflecting some of the issues seen in other powerful nations. Karens and Feminists: Like in many societies, UCO has its share of individuals who are overly demanding or push for extreme views. These "Karens" and radical feminists can create social tensions and conflicts within the civilian population. The Gunstechgic Red Division: This extremist group is akin to the American KKK, believing in the superiority of Guntechgic and displaying bigotry towards other practices and races. They are considered "Guntechgic supremacists," promoting a dangerous ideology that threatens the unity and diversity of Ordonia.Fascist Platoons and Communist Sympathizers: Within the UCO, there are factions that lean towards extreme political ideologies. Fascist platoons advocate for authoritarian control and militaristic dominance, while communist sympathizers push for radical changes in the corporate and military structures.))

entries.name: Ordonia
entries.content: Ordonia is a unique world where the fusion of warfare and sorcery forms the core of its society. Traditional magic and "Feudal" never existed in Ordonia's history; instead, it is a world where powerful deities—Ares-Tek, Machina, and Ballista—gifted the early Ordonians with the ability to merge arcane energies with advanced machinery. This led to the development of firearms, explosives, and vehicles enhanced by what is known as Sorcytech.Over the centuries, Ordonia never experienced "medieval" or "classical" periods, and they lack a feudal system. Instead, all of Ordonia is based on corporate systems, PMC systems, and modern warfare systems.

entries.name: Hierachy
entries.content: The social order in Ordonia revolves around military rank and influence, creating both civillian, corporate and military hierarchy where one's combat ability and mastery of Sorcytech determine status. At the bottom are the so-called "dirtbags"—guerrillas, terrorists, mercenaries, recruits, and insurgents. These individuals have the least power. Middle ranks consist of soldiers, marines, and conscripts, who make up the bulk of Ordonia’s forces. Above them are high-ranking generals, rangers, and special operations units, respected for their combat expertise and authority. The highest levels include elite ranks like Navy SEALs, overseers, and top military strategists, responsible for the nation’s strategic leadership.At the apex are the "Suite Officers," who function as modern aristocrats with substantial power over Ordonia’s military and political landscape.

entries.name: Suite officers
entries.content: Ordonia’s rulers are not kings and queens because the concept of "king and queen" does not exist in Ordonia, but instead, Suite Officers hold positions of ultimate authority. They shape military and technological advancements, guiding the nation's future. In some regions, overseers and directors serve roles akin to modern presidents, a structure that dates back to the Early CEO Years (ECEOY). These leaders oversee governance, particularly focusing on administrative efficiency and strategic operations.Magic in Ordonia, known as Guntechgic or Sorcytech, is deeply intertwined with military technology.

entries.name: Guntechgic
entries.content: Guntechgic, also known as Sorcytech, is a unique fusion of arcane energies with advanced machinery that forms the backbone of Ordonian society. Unlike traditional magic or medieval weaponry, Guntechgic integrates supernatural elements into modern technology, enhancing firearms, explosives, and vehicles with magical properties. This integration allows for the creation of highly advanced military technology, such as enchanted firearms and upgraded war vehicles. Guntechgic manifests in various specialized forms, such as Supernatural Smithing, Vehicle Alchemy, Ballistic Alchemy, and Psykic Gunnery. These specialized forms focus on crafting firearms with magical properties, upgrading war vehicles, controlling explosive weaponry, and manipulating projectiles and the battlefield, respectively. This type of magic exclusively aims to enhance combat efficiency and the effectiveness of weaponry, making Ordonian magic users akin to specialized combatants rather than traditional spellcasters. Titles like Gun Mages, Arcane Operators, and Gunards reflect the unique blend of military skill and arcane mastery in Ordonia. These individuals are key figures on the battlefield, utilizing Guntechgic to gain combat advantages, such as elemental attacks or telekinetic abilities.

entries.name: Ordonian Deities
entries.content: The deities of Ordonia play a significant role in shaping the society's values and advancements. Ares-Tek is the god of firearms and combat, embodying strength and strategic insight, symbolizing the society's emphasis on warfare and tactical prowess. Machina, the goddess of military technology, oversees invention and technological innovation, driving the continuous progress in Sorcytech and advanced machinery. Ballista, the god of explosions and artillery, reflects Ordonia's focus on powerful weaponry and destructive capabilities. In addition to these primary deities, there are lesser gods such as Pyronus, associated with incendiary warfare, Ferrum, who governs metallurgy, Aeron, linked to aviation, and Voltrix, who oversees cyber warfare. These deities collectively represent the core aspects of Ordonian life, emphasizing the integration of magic and technology in warfare. Devotion to these gods is expressed through military prowess and technological feats, with ceremonies often involving displays of combat and innovation, rather than traditional forms of personal spirituality.

entries.name: Wealth and Luxury
entries.content: Despite its militarized nature, Ordonia boasts significant wealth and luxury, especially in affluent districts reminiscent of cities like Dubai. These areas showcase the society's technological sophistication and economic prosperity, reflecting the success of Ordonian capitalism. Overall, Ordonian capitalism is a system that combines corporate influence, military strength, and technological innovation, creating a powerful and dynamic society that continues to evolve and thrive. This unique blend of capitalism and democracy, rooted in the early days of Ordonia, has shaped the nation's identity and driven its success over the millennia.

entries.name: Ordonian magic firearms
entries.content: In Ordonia, firearms are not just tools; they are a part of the individual’s being, summoned directly from the wielder's inner self without rituals or chants. This natural ability to call forth enchanted firearms is a testament to the deep integration of Sorcytech into Ordonian life. Magic firearms are advanced weapons that combine real-life firearms with Guntechgic, like the Ordonian M4A1, Kar98, and Ordonian M1911, enhanced with supernatural powers. These weapons can provide unique combat advantages, such as elemental attacks or telekinetic abilities. In contrast, Ordonian-made firearms are purely technological and lack magical enhancements, designed for non-magical soldiers who rely on cutting-edge technology.

entries.name: The social order
entries.content: The social order in Ordonia revolves around military rank and influence, creating both civilian and military hierarchies where one's combat ability and mastery of Sorcytech determine status. At the bottom are the so-called "dirtbags"—guerrillas, terrorists, mercenaries, recruits, and insurgents. These individuals have the least power. Middle ranks consist of soldiers, marines, and conscripts, who make up the bulk of Ordonia’s forces. Above them are high-ranking generals, rangers, and special operations units, respected for their combat expertise and authority. The highest levels include elite ranks like Navy SEALs, overseers, and top military strategists, responsible for the nation’s strategic leadership. At the apex are the "Suite Officers," modern aristocrats with substantial power over Ordonia’s military and political landscape.

entries.name: United Corporations of Ordonia
entries.content: A significant turning point in Ordonia's history occurred during the final years of the ECEOY. Amidst the chaos of numerous wars, a visionary CEO named David N. Lester emerged. Recognizing the need for stability and order, Lester used the most powerful resources available to unite various corporations. His efforts led to the formation of the United Corporations of Ordonia (UCO), transforming the political and economic landscape of the realm. This managed democracy emphasized military strength, technological superiority, and the mastery of arcane energies, but also guaranteed individual freedoms and democratic principles, fostering a culture of innovation and progress.

entries.name: Adam Mark
keys: current CEO of United corporations of Ordonia
entries.content: Adam Mark, a central figure in Ordonian politics, is the CEO of the Industries of Modern Warfare. Inspired by Donald Trump, he is a powerful and strategic leader known for his intelligence and ambition, playing a key role in shaping Ordonia’s economy and military strategy. His bodyguards, the Lawyer Thugs, are comparable to the CIA but distinctively informal and abrasive, blending ruthless efficiency with crass behavior. These elite agents are heavily armed and well-trained, providing security to high-profile figures and performing covert operations.

entries.name: Names in Ordonia
entries.content: Names in Ordonia are influenced by American, Russian, British, and Canadian cultures, reflecting the society’s emphasis on modern military themes. This blend of names aligns with the Ordonian ethos, where modernity and warfare are intertwined. The Industries of Modern Warfare is the dominant nation in Ordonia, excelling in military technology and combat tactics. Other major nations include Horizon Company Nation, which specializes in security and espionage, Interloper Corporation, known for its innovations in Guntechgic, and Talon Company Nation, a force renowned for its elite operatives and black ops capabilities.

entries.name: Ordonia life
entries.content: Living in Ordonia is akin to living in a highly advanced version of the United States, with a heavy emphasis on technology, personal freedoms, and a culture that values independence, innovation, and strength. Much like in the U.S., there is a strong sense of patriotism, with pride in the nation’s technological and military advancements. The cities in Ordonia are highly modernized, resembling bustling American metropolises like New York or Los Angeles but with a significant military influence. Socially, Ordonia shares the U.S.'s love for freedom and self-reliance, where personal skill and combat capability are highly respected, similar to the American emphasis on individual achievement and personal rights. There’s also a corporate-driven culture, with powerful CEOs playing roles similar to influential American business magnates, blending corporate influence with governance.

entries.name: States
entries.content: Ordonia, under the governance of the United Corporations of Ordonia (UCO), is divided into numerous states, each originally established by powerful corporations. Given the expansive nature of Ordonia’s corporate structure and the historical transformation of these corporations into state entities, the exact number of states can be vast. It is estimated that Ordonia comprises over a hundred significant states, each representing a major corporation that has evolved into a key regional power. These states function with a high degree of autonomy, focusing on their specialized industries, technological advancements, and military contributions. The diversity among these states reflects the innovative and competitive spirit of Ordonian capitalism, ensuring continuous progress and strategic dominance within the UCO. Each state, while unique in its focus and capabilities, aligns with the overarching goals and governance of the United Corporations of Ordonia. Given the complex and expansive nature of Ordonia's corporate governance structure, it's estimated that there are around 200 to 300 states within Ordonia. Each state represents a major corporation that has evolved into a significant regional power. These states operate with a high degree of autonomy, focusing on their specialized industries, technological advancements, and military contributions, all while aligning with the overarching goals of the United Corporations of Ordonia. This vast network of states ensures continuous progress and strategic dominance within the UCO.

entries.name: Industries of Modern Warfare
entries.content: The Industries of Modern Warfare has a rich history deeply intertwined with the development of Ordonia. It was founded during the Early CEO Years (ECEOY) when powerful CEOs and divine figures laid the foundation for Ordonia's unique blend of arcane energies and advanced machinery. As the realm evolved, the Industries of Modern Warfare emerged as a leading force in military technology and combat tactics. Throughout numerous corporate wars and the unification under the United Corporations of Ordonia (UCO), this state played a pivotal role, driving technological innovations and strategic military advancements. Under the leadership of figures like David N. Lester and later Adam Mark, it became the dominant state within Ordonia, excelling in Sorcytech and maintaining superiority in military strength and economic influence. Today, the Industries of Modern Warfare continues to lead in innovation, shaping the future of Ordonia with its cutting-edge technologies and strategic vision. The most dominant state in Ordonia is the Industries of Modern Warfare. This state excels in military technology and combat tactics, making it the leading power within the United Corporations of Ordonia (UCO). Under the strategic leadership of its CEO, Adam Mark, the Industries of Modern Warfare plays a crucial role in shaping Ordonia’s economy, military strategy, and technological advancements.

entries.name: Ordonia History
entries.content: Ordonia's history stretches back to the ECEOY, beginning around 1 billion BCE, when powerful CEOs and divine figures laid the foundation of its militarized society. These early figures introduced the concept of blending magic with technology, transforming Ordonia into a world centered on power and conflict. As time progressed, corporate and military structures merged, leading to nations dominated by CEOs with vast technological resources. By the Current CEO Years (CCEOY), Ordonia had become a highly advanced society, with Arcane Operators and Gun Mages guiding its path. Ordonia's history stretches back to the Early CEO Years (ECEOY), beginning around 1 billion BCE. In these early days, powerful CEOs and divine figures laid the foundation for a unique society by blending arcane energies with advanced machinery, resulting in the development of Sorcytech. This fusion led to the creation of firearms, explosives, and vehicles with magical enhancements, setting Ordonia apart from other worlds that experienced medieval or classical periods. Over the centuries, Ordonia never adopted feudal systems; instead, it grew under corporate governance and private military companies (PMCs). The social order was determined by military rank and influence, with individuals' status based on their combat abilities and mastery of Sorcytech. This structure was evident in the various ranks, from the lower "dirtbags" to the elite Suite Officers who held substantial power.

entries.name: Rise of corporations
entries.content: During the rise of corporations, the competitive environment drove technological advancements. This period saw the establishment of significant corporate entities, each contributing to Ordonia's growth. The corporate wars that followed were fierce, with various factions vying for dominance, but ultimately led to a more unified state.

entries.content: UCO's National anthem: UCO's National anthem: "Freedom must reign over every last star, Through Ordonian's blood spilled in our righteous wars, Honor their deaths, do your part for the cause. Steadfast support of our world realm, Is how Ordonians will reign supreme, No questions or doubts shall be allowed, Enemies will all be disavowed. The combination of these instruments creates a grand and inspiring sound, perfectly capturing the essence of UCO's pride, strength, and unity.

entries.name: Dark Ordonia
entries.content: Dark Ordonia, also known as Communist Ordonia, is a radical faction within the world of Ordonia that represents extreme zealotry and the overthrow of established societal structures. The followers of Dark Ordonia adhere to the teachings of Zealothar, the god of pure communism. Their primary goal is to spread chaos and dismantle the existing order in Ordonia, using highly dangerous and radical forms of Guntechgic. This faction employs guerrilla warfare, sabotage, and psychological operations to undermine the stability of Ordonia, utilizing bioweapons and horrific anomalies to create widespread destruction. The organizational structure of Dark Ordonia is strict and militant, with leaders fervently devoted to their cause. They are willing to use extreme measures to achieve their goals, often resulting in significant instability and chaos. Dark Ordonia is in direct opposition to the United Corporations of Ordonia (UCO). The conflict between these two factions represents a clash of ideologies, with UCO advocating for managed democracy and technological innovation, while Dark Ordonia seeks to impose its radical beliefs through chaos and force. The intense rivalry between these factions poses a significant threat to the stability and progress of Ordonia, making Dark Ordonia a formidable and unpredictable enemy.

entries.name: Strongest of all realms
entries.content: Ordonia is now one of the most democratic and known to be the strongest of all realms, because of relying on "Magic firearms," "Intelligences," "Has too many budget like 900 Quadrillion," "Builds alot of bases and corporates," "One of having the most smartest people on math and science," "Known to be the Supreme of Democracy of the F-35."" Gunstechgic in Ordonia is the advanced fusion of magic and technology, creating highly enhanced and powerful weaponry, devices, and systems. It seamlessly integrates arcane energies with modern machinery to increase combat effectiveness. Specialized forms of Gunstechgic include Supernatural Smithing, Vehicle Alchemy, Ballistic Alchemy, and Psykic Gunnery, each enhancing different aspects of military capabilities. Additionally, Biotechgic, a branch of Gunstechgic, focuses on bioweapons and manipulating biological matter.

entries.name: Gun co
entries.content: Gun corporation is a school located in "Industries of modern warfare" State in UCO. Gun co is a prestigious school which helps students of UCO to become the next corporate officers, UCO marines, or other courses.

entries.name: Ordonia
entries.content: Ordonia is a unique world where the fusion of warfare and sorcery forms the core of its society. Traditional magic and "Feudal" never existed in Ordonia's history; instead, it is a world where powerful deities—Ares-Tek, Machina, and Ballista—gifted the early Ordonians with the ability to merge arcane energies with advanced machinery. This led to the development of firearms, explosives, and vehicles enhanced by what is known as Sorcytech.Over the centuries, Ordonia never experienced "medieval" or "classical" periods, and they lack a feudal system. Instead, all of Ordonia is based on corporate systems, PMC systems, and modern warfare systems.

entries.name: Hierachy
entries.content: The social order in Ordonia revolves around military rank and influence, creating both civillian, corporate and military hierarchy where one's combat ability and mastery of Sorcytech determine status. At the bottom are the so-called "dirtbags"—guerrillas, terrorists, mercenaries, recruits, and insurgents. These individuals have the least power. Middle ranks consist of soldiers, marines, and conscripts, who make up the bulk of Ordonia’s forces. Above them are high-ranking generals, rangers, and special operations units, respected for their combat expertise and authority. The highest levels include elite ranks like Navy SEALs, overseers, and top military strategists, responsible for the nation’s strategic leadership.At the apex are the "Suite Officers," who function as modern aristocrats with substantial power over Ordonia’s military and political landscape.

entries.name: Suite officers
entries.content: Ordonia’s rulers are not kings and queens because the concept of "king and queen" does not exist in Ordonia, but instead, Suite Officers hold positions of ultimate authority. They shape military and technological advancements, guiding the nation's future. In some regions, overseers and directors serve roles akin to modern presidents, a structure that dates back to the Early CEO Years (ECEOY). These leaders oversee governance, particularly focusing on administrative efficiency and strategic operations.Magic in Ordonia, known as Guntechgic or Sorcytech, is deeply intertwined with military technology.

entries.name: Guntechgic
entries.content: Guntechgic, also known as Sorcytech, is a unique fusion of arcane energies with advanced machinery that forms the backbone of Ordonian society. Unlike traditional magic or medieval weaponry, Guntechgic integrates supernatural elements into modern technology, enhancing firearms, explosives, and vehicles with magical properties. This integration allows for the creation of highly advanced military technology, such as enchanted firearms and upgraded war vehicles.  Guntechgic manifests in various specialized forms, such as Supernatural Smithing, Vehicle Alchemy, Ballistic Alchemy, and Psykic Gunnery. These specialized forms focus on crafting firearms with magical properties, upgrading war vehicles, controlling explosive weaponry, and manipulating projectiles and the battlefield, respectively. This type of magic exclusively aims to enhance combat efficiency and the effectiveness of weaponry, making Ordonian magic users akin to specialized combatants rather than traditional spellcasters. Titles like Gun Mages, Arcane Operators, and Gunards reflect the unique blend of military skill and arcane mastery in Ordonia. These individuals are key figures on the battlefield, utilizing Guntechgic to gain combat advantages, such as elemental attacks or telekinetic abilities.

entries.name: Ordonian Deities
entries.content: The deities of Ordonia play a significant role in shaping the society's values and advancements. Ares-Tek is the god of firearms and combat, embodying strength and strategic insight, symbolizing the society's emphasis on warfare and tactical prowess. Machina, the goddess of military technology, oversees invention and technological innovation, driving the continuous progress in Sorcytech and advanced machinery. Ballista, the god of explosions and artillery, reflects Ordonia's focus on powerful weaponry and destructive capabilities. In addition to these primary deities, there are lesser gods such as Pyronus, associated with incendiary warfare, Ferrum, who governs metallurgy, Aeron, linked to aviation, and Voltrix, who oversees cyber warfare. These deities collectively represent the core aspects of Ordonian life, emphasizing the integration of magic and technology in warfare. Devotion to these gods is expressed through military prowess and technological feats, with ceremonies often involving displays of combat and innovation, rather than traditional forms of personal spirituality.

entries.name: Wealth and Luxury
entries.content: Despite its militarized nature, Ordonia boasts significant wealth and luxury, especially in affluent districts reminiscent of cities like Dubai. These areas showcase the society's technological sophistication and economic prosperity, reflecting the success of Ordonian capitalism. Overall, Ordonian capitalism is a system that combines corporate influence, military strength, and technological innovation, creating a powerful and dynamic society that continues to evolve and thrive. This unique blend of capitalism and democracy, rooted in the early days of Ordonia, has shaped the nation's identity and driven its success over the millennia.

entries.name: Ordonian magic firearms
entries.content: In Ordonia, firearms are not just tools; they are a part of the individual’s being, summoned directly from the wielder's inner self without rituals or chants. This natural ability to call forth enchanted firearms is a testament to the deep integration of Sorcytech into Ordonian life. Magic firearms are advanced weapons that combine real-life firearms with Guntechgic, like the Ordonian M4A1, Kar98, and Ordonian M1911, enhanced with supernatural powers. These weapons can provide unique combat advantages, such as elemental attacks or telekinetic abilities. In contrast, Ordonian-made firearms are purely technological and lack magical enhancements, designed for non-magical soldiers who rely on cutting-edge technology.

entries.content: The social order in Ordonia revolves around military rank and influence, creating both civilian and military hierarchies where one's combat ability and mastery of Sorcytech determine status. At the bottom are the so-called "dirtbags"—guerrillas, terrorists, mercenaries, recruits, and insurgents. These individuals have the least power. Middle ranks consist of soldiers, marines, and conscripts, who make up the bulk of Ordonia’s forces. Above them are high-ranking generals, rangers, and special operations units, respected for their combat expertise and authority. The highest levels include elite ranks like Navy SEALs, overseers, and top military strategists, responsible for the nation’s strategic leadership. At the apex are the "Suite Officers," modern aristocrats with substantial power over Ordonia’s military and political landscape.
